title: Post-MD differential tight-binding discrete/continuum analysis
summary: Build provisional geometric clusters for a completed solution trajectory, refine them by certified electronic fluctuation residuals, evaluate each final representative independently at the accurate level, and transfer only resident tight-binding energy, Hamiltonian and gradient fluctuations within the same immutable explicit-solvent/ellipsoid cluster.
gates: accurate calculations are external reference calculations on cluster representatives
explicit near-solvent membership and ellipsoidal continuum contract are immutable within each cluster
far solvent uses declared pure-solvent charges with an optional published additive hydrogen-bond correction
geometric clusters are provisional and are bisected deterministically when the electronic fluctuation residual exceeds either frozen threshold
every final cluster carries a complete electronic certificate; a depth-limited or undersized unqualified cluster is a hard protocol failure
state permutation and phase are matched from electronic descriptors before Hamiltonian subtraction
a discontinuous state character or explicit-region crossing starts a new cluster
corrected energy and analytic gradient obey one conservative differential expression
coordinate_policy: Every frame uses the representative atom map and fixed explicit region; geometry derivatives are Cartesian and may subsequently be transformed by LINK/SMITH.
backend_policy: No polarizable force field or ONIOM interpolation is used: an independently computed accurate representative is combined with resident tight-binding fluctuations and the declared discrete/continuum environment.
